scope: CameraPlan direction, intensity and curve are structured and immutable inside ShotRevision fields
one explicit Published Profile resolves support as NATIVE, PROMPT_FALLBACK or UNSUPPORTED
missing capability is truthfully UNSUPPORTED and cannot mark a shot Production Ready
resolution is read-only and records runtime_contacted=false, network_contacted=false and mutated=false
the UI exposes the structured editor and disables production readiness until a runnable resolution exists
remaining: Capture a real browser UAT against a user-selected Published Profile whose camera capability is explicitly declared
Bind the resolved CameraPlan into the formal GenerationVariant submission snapshot during the generation-workbench closure batch
release_claim: This closes the structured editor and authoritative capability-resolution layer; it does not by itself close the full master requirements ledger.
